chunks: And he (peace be upon him) said:
He who does not know his own worth is ruined.
ai.seo_question: What is the consequence of not knowing one's own worth according to Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: In this concise maxim from Nahj al-Balagha, Imam Ali (peace be upon him) links spiritual ruin to a lack of self-knowledge, a concept deeply rooted in the Shia tradition where knowing oneself is often seen as the gateway to knowing God. This warning against self-ignorance underscores the necessity of balancing humility with an accurate assessment of one's God-given potential and duties. It serves as a practical guide for believers to avoid both the arrogance of overestimation and the despair of underestimation.

en.sayed-ali-raza: 149. Amīr al-mu’minīn, peace be upon him,
said: He who does not know his own worth is ruined.
